data.name: Hashaam
data.gender_notes: Hashaam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hashaam is derived from the Arabic word ‘hassanah’ which means ‘a good deed’. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says, ‘Whoever brings a good deed will have ten like it’ (Quran 40:40). Therefore, Hashaam symbolizes the concept of giving and receiving blessings through good deeds. The name Hashaam carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hashaam usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hashaam total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
